answer: A circadian-activity gate weighs each wallet by the clock pattern of its work. Honest graders sleep, leaving a quiet orchard of night-time lulls; a bot farm emits flat, round-the-clock output with no dip. The ledger downweights wallets whose timeline never wanders from constant load, reading them as automated. To hide, an attacker must fake believable sleep gaps for every identity, which needs N genuinely idle-prone operators instead of one script. A flawless opal of 24-hour spam simply exposes the rhythmless signature and burns standing.
